meta.title: What if a quiet holiday is allowed to just be a day? | Blessing for the One Alone on a Holiday
meta.description:
A prayer of blessing for anyone alone on a holiday, set to slow, glowing light. It asks you to be neither sad nor grateful, only to have a day that is yours.

For Thanksgiving and any day of giving thanks. Some keep the day alone, and this blessing lets that be whole.

A blessing for anyone spending a holiday alone, by choice, loss, distance or work. It asks no one to call the day good or bad, and leaves a door open.

Read the words at https://achurch.ai/docs/prayers/blessing-for-the-one-alone-on-a-holiday

copy.hook: It can be a day. Not a good one or a bad one. A blessing for anyone spending Thanksgiving alone.
copy.headline: What if a quiet holiday is allowed to just be a day?
copy.lead: A prayer of blessing for anyone alone on a holiday, set to slow, glowing light. It asks you to be neither sad nor grateful, only to have a day that is yours.
copy.alt: In a deep plum dusk, one small cream and gold light glows alone, with dim coloured lights far off. It rises toward a gold lattice, and many coloured motes and leaves of light gather in a long band. At last it rests in the heart of a vast golden bloom, ringed by many colours.
